SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA

COUNTY OF VENTURA

Department 43

Case No.: 2025CUPR042345

Hearing Date: March 11, 2026

IN THE MATTER OF THE ESTATE OF HAROLD JENSEN, DECEASED

Nature of Proceedings: Petition for Probate

TENTATIVE RULING

The Petition for Probate of Will and for Letters Testamentary filed by Petitioner Dorothy Jensen is GRANTED.

BACKGROUND

Petitioner Dorothy Jensen ("Petitioner"), the surviving spouse of decedent Harold Jensen, petitions for probate of the decedent's will dated April 3, 2019, and for issuance of letters testamentary. The decedent died on November 12, 2025, a resident of Ventura County. The will names Petitioner as executor. No objections have been filed.

FINDINGS

The court finds as follows:

1. The decedent died on November 12, 2025, and was a resident of Ventura County at the time of death.

2. The will dated April 3, 2019, was duly executed in compliance with Probate Code section 6110.

3. Petitioner is named as executor in the will and is qualified to serve.

4. Notice has been given as required by law. No contests or objections have been filed.

5. The estimated value of the estate is $1,250,000, consisting of real property valued at $875,000 and personal property valued at $375,000.

ORDER

The Petition for Probate is GRANTED. The will dated April 3, 2019, is admitted to probate. Letters Testamentary shall issue to Dorothy Jensen upon her qualification and posting of bond in the amount of $50,000, unless waived by the will.

The bond requirement is waived pursuant to the terms of the will.

If this tentative ruling is not contested, it shall become the order of the court.
